name: Lukya
description: The copper wolf with turquoise eyes who becomes Lathril's guide and companion, sent by the wolf lord.

timeline.summary: Lathril wakes to find a copper wolf in her bed, evidently sent by Sarulf.
timeline.quote: she found herself face-to-face with a pair of turquoise eyes, set in the face of a beautiful copper wolf

timeline.summary: The wolf leads Lathril to the door where a harness hangs, and Lathril follows her out into the village.
timeline.quote: But the wolf led her to the tall green door that led out into the village.

timeline.summary: Yadira meets Lathril and tells her she and the wolf are summoned to deal with a problem between worlds.
timeline.quote: you've been summoned to deal with a problem.

timeline.summary: Lathril tells the wolf to take her where she is most needed, and an Omenpath opens.
timeline.quote: Lathril followed as an Omenpath opened ahead of them, and they stepped through without a pause or a question.

timeline.summary: Lathril hears a scream and rushes into a clearing with the wolf to defend a girl.
timeline.quote: The wolf didn't react until she was ready, then they charged ahead

timeline.summary: Lathril returns Lyana to her village and tells the elder she found one of their children.
timeline.quote: I believe I've found one of your children,

timeline.summary: Lathril finds the draugr camp with Kit chained to a stake.
timeline.quote: At the end of that chain was a wolf, a small one.

timeline.summary: Lathril waits for the men to sleep and works the lock on Kit's chain.
timeline.quote: Lathril successfully worked the lock on the pup's chain

timeline.summary: Lost in the forest, Lathril finds the giant wolf in a glade with the two wolves bowing to him.
timeline.quote: Ahead of her, a giant wolf curled up in the middle of a glade, and the two wolves with whom she had escaped were bowing low to him.

timeline.summary: The giant wolf names her companion Lukya and accepts Lathril's service.
timeline.quote: You have accepted the one that I sent you. Her name is Lukya.

timeline.summary: Lathril walks back through the Omenpath with her new wolf companion.
timeline.quote: The Omenpath was opening, and Lathril walked through it

relations.note: Lukya becomes Lathril's companion and guide.
relations.quote: with her new friend safely at her side

relations.note: Lathril assumes the wolf is one of Sarulf's wolf children sent to his chosen.
relations.quote: There was only one divine being that sent wolf children to his chosen, and that was Sarulf.

pages_say.description: The copper wolf with turquoise eyes who becomes Lathril's guide and companion, sent by the wolf lord.
